notes: Copy to backend/runs/probes/probe-plan.json (gitignored); paths are relative to the plan file.

certificates: a scratch folder of files written by 'python -m app.estate.wcf_probe --make-certificates' (WcfClientProbe make-certificates): server.pfx, server.cer, client.pfx, client.cer, pfx.password. No certificate store is read or written; the client pins server.cer, the services pin client.cer.
The services are the WCF sample's and wcf-backend's, run from copies under backend/runs/probes/wcf-sample, never the registered repositories:
basicHttp-None-None: wcf-backend's FundsTransferWS under IIS Express (WCF-backend/scripts/Start-FundsTransferWS.ps1), plain HTTP.

basicHttp-Transport-None.service: WCF sample UtilityService, Hosting.Iis binding (ProbeServices, TLS from a certificate file)

netTcp-Transport-Certificate.service: WCF sample AccountService, Catalog.Host binding, mutual TLS (ProbeServices)

wsHttp-TransportWithMessageCredential-Ce.service: WCF sample AccountService, Hosting.Iis binding (ProbeServices, TLS from a certificate file)
